remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks and Whitney Archive indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. Two dark green alligator pears on greenish–white drapery. . . . Painted 1923." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: Alligator Pears 1923?" [not verified]. Pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. Orientation differs from installation photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
